requirements.requirement: The system must accept a list of two or more provider identifiers and initiate a comparison operation.
The system must retrieve provider quality scores for each input provider using the EVAL-SCORE-PROV dependency.
The system must aggregate all retrieved provider scores into a unified comparison data structure.
The system must normalize provider scores onto a common scale before ranking.
The system must rank providers in descending order based on normalized overall quality scores.
The system must compute measure-level score comparisons across providers.
The system must identify at least one relative strength per provider based on top-performing measures.
The system must identify at least one relative weakness per provider based on lowest-performing measures.
The system must use the EVAL-EXPLAIN dependency to generate explanation data for strengths and weaknesses.
The system must return a structured output consistent with the schema defined in EVAL-COMPARE-ST-001.
The system must preserve deterministic ranking order for identical input data across repeated executions.
The system must handle tied normalized scores by applying a consistent tie-breaking rule or preserving equal rank.
The system must include all input providers in the output even if some have partial measure data.
The system must flag providers with missing score components in the comparison output.
The system must complete comparison processing within acceptable latency for up to N providers as defined by system constraints.
The system must raise an error if fewer than two providers are provided in the input.
The system must raise an error if provider score retrieval fails for all requested providers.
The system must proceed with comparison if at least one provider has valid scores and at least two providers are present, even if others fail.
The system must ensure normalization does not distort relative ordering of original scores.
The system must compute strengths and weaknesses relative to the comparison group rather than absolute thresholds.
